notes.title: Chill Train - Densha no kuni is now available!
notes.content:
Welcome, train enthusiast!

In "Chill Train - Densha no Kuni," explore the small regional line "Shuppatsu-eki - Densha Terminal" and strive to become an exceptional train driver by mastering 40 routes of varying duration and difficulty.
With a bit of perseverance, you might even get to pilot the express train "Inazuma" to put your skills to the ultimate test on 8 routes!
But before you dive in, don’t hesitate to complete the tutorial to learn all the nuances of train driving. ^^

So don’t wait any longer—hop aboard the regional train to simply have fun and relax or aim for excellence! ^^
